title: redact misses backslash-escaped JSON assignments and headers, a subscripted Authorization header and an escaped quote inside a value
goal: redact replaces the value of {\"password\": \"v\"} and {\"Authorization\": \"Bearer v\"} (JSON inside a JSON or shell string), headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer v', and the whole of a quoted value holding an escaped quote; a second pass changes nothing. SP-yyjwfjtc review gap 3.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import redact as R;v="Fake"+"Pass12345x";b=chr(92)+chr(34);o=R.redact("{"+b+"password"+b+": "+b+v+b+"}");print(o);sys.exit(1 if v in o else 0)
